subject: BENCHSARGENT
name: White Ships — transparent hull planes and warm rigging

styleSelection.reason: Pure watercolor: reserved paper and pale blue-grey hull planes, with warm ropes and dark painted fittings. No opening or closing drawing.

families.referenceCue: Warm ochre ropes and narrow cool structure at left: pale foundation, dry, connected tapered painted shapes and small light gaps.
Rounded blue-grey central bow: pale continuous wash, dry, two middle planes, selected softened turning edges and irregular light facets. Crisp dark oval fitting last.
Right white hull: cream paper lights and pale blue shadow planes, lost internal light edges, firm upper rigging and oval fittings. Preserve the white shape.
Dark blue-green reflection below central bow, lighter green water at right, broken cream glints. Pale underwash, dry middle planes, final connected shadow glazes across hull and reflection.
Slanted warm rope crosses pale hull and green water: dry-paper ochre and burnt-sienna shape, fitted taper and interrupted light side, no ink contour.
